dungeonDesc.text:
The massive factory belched thick, noxious exhaust from its pipes. Who is trying to hide their secrets here? 
"Draw your steel and raise those shields! Let howl the tuskbeasts of war! And heat up that haze!"

featureDesc.text:
- Careful. The Mist continuously deals DMG to all operators.
 - When the controlled operator receives HP treatment, other operators in the team also gain 70% of that HP treatment.

description.text: A small warbeast controlled by the Landbreakers. Ripptusks are far more bloodthirsty and ferocious than their untamed wilderness kin. They are absolutely loyal to the Landbreakers who tamed them.
An elite Landbreaker warbeast enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular ripptusk is more ferocious and cunning, and attacks with less predictable moves.
An elite Landbreaker ranged combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is better trained and more accurate, and is armed with better crossbow and bolts.

A Bonekrusher combatant armed with spears and shields. Though armed with weapons crudely cobbled together, the vanguard has developed a combat technique that unites attack and defense. Practice caution when fighting this foe.

A Landbreaker combatant equipped with heavy explosive gauntlets. These serve as the mainstay of Bonekrusher mobs. A Siegeknuckles's gauntlets serve as portable weapons for taking down fortified positions.
A tuskbeast corrupted by hazefyre. These small aberrations usually move in packs and can pose a serious threat, even to fully armed field teams.
A Landbreaker armed with melee weapons. Infiltrators are extremely agile and capable combatants who fight with two weapons at once. They are not to be trifled with.

decoDesc.text: A data storage unit developed by Endfield Industries. It is compatible with various data access devices. New operators can use it to effectively acquire combat knowledge. Thanks to support offered by the Cabal of Tranquility, this carrier features data compression technology and thus stores even more information.

desc.text: A material that provides a lot of EXP for leveling up Lv.61-90 operators.

decoDesc.text: A single-use toolset with AIC technology. Provides automated in-depth inspection of the entire weapon structure. Also repairs internal material damage and significantly enhances weapon performance.

desc.text: A material that provides a lot of weapon EXP.

decoDesc.text: A special crystal polyhedron manufactured using Techno-Protocol and advanced crystallization processes. Often combined with other devices to improve physiological absorption of enhancement materials.

desc.text: A material that upgrades operator skills.

decoDesc.text: A popular currency furnished with highly advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies. You know it's good money when you can purchase things with it.

desc.text: TC for short. This currency is recognized and used in many places.

decoDesc.text: The perseverance of life and continuation of civilization have left their marks upon this place.

desc.text: A rare material that upgrades operator skill mastery.

dungeonDesc.text:
The comm devices gave piercing screeches as drones crashed into the ground. The Landbreakers turned to look as they mumbled desires for "blessings" and "vengeance". 
Behind them stood tall shadowy figures amongst the forest of denstacks.

featureDesc.text: - Enemies cannot move, but they are harder to interrupt and continuously gain ATK.

description.text: A Landbreaker armed with basic ranged weaponry. Ambushers only received the most rudimentary training and their shots are inaccurate. Nevertheless, their bolts have claimed more than a few lives.
An elite Landbreaker ranged combatant enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is better trained and more accurate, and is armed with better crossbow and bolts.

A creature that spews highly corrosive fluids. Nidwyrms usually live underground. They would dissolve metallic materials with acids before consuming them. Nidwyrm hunters are therefore advised to take proper care of their weapons.

dungeonDesc.text:
The Bonekrusher warriors eviscerated the weak and stood atop the platform with their axe and ballista raised. Defeat them and lay both ancient suffering and newfound ambition in the dust. 
"Hero? How did you earn this title?"

featureDesc.text: - The 2 elite enemies will fight as a team.

description.text: A Landbreaker armed with a heavy axe. These massive brutes are way more powerful than their common counterparts and can easily damage defensive works or flip over armored vehicles.
A Landbreaker armed with a heavy ranged weapon. Ballistas are elites selected from Ambushers who proved their worth. Their heavy bolts are capable of punching right through heavy body armor.
